caseNameFull: In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Lee Daniel GOTTESMAN.

opinions.text:
In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Lee Daniel GOTTESMAN.

Lee Daniel Gottesman, of Toms River, New Jersey, is suspended from the practice of law in this Court and a rule will issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring him to show cause why he should not be *442disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
